text:
sara: Hey folks — CI failing on go-sdk sampleapp after latest regen. Auth/retry parity tests are red. Anyone seen this? :grimacing:
ci-bot: build failed · regendiff detected changes in openapi examples -> see snippet: `examples.user.create` order changed, causing typegen to treat as breaking. Logs: `FAIL auth_parity_test.go:45`
vinod: ugh. which commit? can you paste regendiff output?
sara: https://ci.internal/12345/regendiff — main culprit seems to be 8f9d2b7 (openapi: reorder examples for consistency). The diff is tiny but typehash flipped.
jen: I noticed the openapi generator sorts example keys now by insertion order instead of stable sort. That will flip deterministic outputs across languages.
matt: quick workaround: we can pin typegen to the previous sort behavior with `--stable-examples=true` in the regen job, but that's a bandaid.
tia: the real problem is the changelog semver automation — it saw the regendiff and suggested a major bump because examples moved, which is wrong. It flags any example ordering change as breaking.
kate: the release script parses `openapi: examples` diffs as "API surface" changes. We should refine heuristics to ignore ordering-only diffs.
vinod: can we add a lightweight canonicalize step before hashing? e.g. sort example keys and strip whitespace from descriptions. That would avoid spurious typehash churn.
jen: yes — and add a test in regen CI that ensures stable hash for a repo with only example reorders. I'm happy to open a patch.
sara: plan: (1) revert 8f9d2b7 in the sampleapp branch to unblock publish, (2) add canonicalize step in regen pipeline, (3) tighten changelog semver heuristics to ignore example-order-only diffs. Anyone object?
matt: +1, also propose a short-term override in the release bot to ignore this single PR so we don't force a semver bump.
tia: I'll file an issue for the semver classifier and add unit tests.
vinod: I'll do the revert and the override. PR incoming in ~30m.
sara: thanks — if someone can pick up the pipeline patch, we can avoid repeating this. @jen you volunteered? :pray:
jen: yep, taking it. will follow up with a small regen CI job that canonicalizes examples and compares typehash.
ci-bot: note: re-run queued builds may still pick up regenerated artifacts — recommend manual restart after revert.
sara: acknowledged. thanks all! :thumbsup:
